data.name: Sheraton Grand Rio Hotel & Resort
data.address: Av. Niemeyer, 121 - Leblon, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, 22450-220, Brazil
data.description:
This upscale beachfront hotel is 3.9 km from Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden and 15 km from the iconic Christ the Redeemer statue.
Refined rooms with partial sea views have free Wi-Fi and flat-screens. Upgraded rooms add oceanfront balconies, sitting areas and/or kitchenettes, while suites offer lounges with pull-out sofas; some have pianos and whirlpool tubs. Room service is available. Select rooms have access to a club lounge.
Amenities include multiple bar and dining options such as fine dining and a pizza bar, plus 3 outdoor pools, a spa and a kids' club. Tennis courts and a free beach shuttle are also available.
